source.captured_from: BOOT partition /dev/sda14 (live device readback) and the running userspace
source.repository_head: the commit named by the annotated v0.7.4-beta tag (created by the release workflow from the merged main commit)

installed_boot_image.content: the complete live BOOT partition read back from /dev/sda14 on the phone; a complete, flashable boot image
installed_boot_image.note: captured from the running handset; the full partition and the shipped image are the same bytes

installed_userspace_manifest.note: live capture from the running phone; a hash inventory, not a rootfs block snapshot

ci_built_image.note: The workflow also rebuilds the current repository sources for this release and publishes that archive next to these captured live bytes. It is NOT byte-identical to the installed image; the captured image above is the exact handset image.

rootfs.note: The root filesystem is a live, mounted read-write ext4 filesystem. A consistent block-device snapshot needs an owner-approved freeze/remount; this release therefore does not present a live rootfs copy as an exact installed image. It ships the exact installed BOOT image and a hash inventory of the installed userspace files instead.

provenance.boot_partition_read: dd if=/dev/sda14 bs=1M status=none | gzip -9 -n on the device; decompressed sha256 2cbc5085d871d043baea6e64aec6c94df60adae18b86fa8696ad942f46b748fc for the complete 57671680-byte partition
provenance.trimmed_image_read: not applicable: the shipped image is the complete BOOT partition
provenance.workflow_note: The CI image builder produces a source rebuild for the current repository; the release workflow also publishes the captured installed image and labels both explicitly.
provenance.verification: gzip integrity, decompressed size/SHA-256, ANDROID! v1 header, page size, raw arm64 Image, kernel/ramdisk hashes and the full-partition readback hash are verified by tools/release/verify-installed-image.py before any release.

installed_boot_partition.note: The complete BOOT partition is shipped; no stale trailing bytes are omitted.
